meta.name: docx
meta.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx files) or Word templates (.dotx files). Triggers include: any mention of 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', or requests to produce professional documents with formatting like tables of contents, headings, page numbers, or letterheads. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, performing find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file, use this skill. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or general coding tasks unrelated to document generation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建并编辑带格式的Word文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要制作或修改格式复杂的Word文档。
copy.tagline_en: Create and edit formatted Word documents.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently produce or modify Word documents with complex formatting.

howto.what: 你能让 Claude 直接创建、阅读和修改 Word 文档。它会生成带目录、标题、页码等格式的 .docx 文件;也能打开已有文档改文字、加批注,并把结果转成图片检查效果。
howto.when: 当你提到 Word 文档、.docx、.dotx 等词,或要求生成带目录、页码的报告/信函,或要求修改、批注 Word 文件时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一份带目录和页码的季度报告,保存为 .docx
say.note: 会用它生成带格式的 Word 文档

say.text: 把这份合同里所有"费用"改成"报价",保留修订痕迹
say.note: 会改 XML,并检查修订都被正确标记

say.text: 把这份 .docx 的内容提取成文字给我
say.note: 会用 pandoc 转成纯文本读出来

howto.what_en: Claude can create, read, and edit Word documents. It produces formatted .docx files (table of contents, headings, page numbers), can modify existing files by editing their XML, and can render the result to images for visual checking.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention Word docs, .docx, .dotx, or ask for a formatted report/memo/letter, or to edit/comment on a Word file.

say_en.text: Write a .docx report with a table of contents and page numbers.
say_en.note: It will generate a formatted Word document.

say_en.text: In this contract, change all 'fee' to 'quote' and track the changes.
say_en.note: It edits the XML and verifies tracked revisions.

say_en.text: Extract the text from this .docx file and show it to me.
say_en.note: It converts the file to Markdown with pandoc.
